# Surface Collapse

Sub-zero Seattle blizzard where every roof collapsed. Carl stepped onto the porch in boxers and a leather jacket to rescue Princess Donut.

quests.name: Milestone 1: The Midnight Porch & The Descent into Cold Iron
quests.title: Milestone 1: The Midnight Porch & The Descent into Cold Iron
quests.description: Chasing Princess Donut into the sub-zero Seattle snow in boxer shorts and pink Crocs, Carl witnesses his apartment building compressed into a solid block. Grabbing Donut, he ignores freezing pain and plunges into the glowing, wrought-iron staircase leading beneath Earth's crust.
quests.notes:
**Milestone & Crucible:** Milestone 1: The Midnight Porch & The Descent into Cold Iron (Q_M1_the_midnight_porch_the_descent_into_cold_iron)

**Floor & Phase:** Surface Collapse / Floor 1 Entry (`ph_01`, The World Collapse & The Snowy Descent)

**Canonical Outcome:**
Chasing Princess Donut into the sub-zero Seattle snow in boxer shorts and pink Crocs, Carl witnesses his apartment building compressed into a solid block. Grabbing Donut, he ignores freezing pain and plunges into the glowing, wrought-iron staircase leading beneath Earth's crust.

**Crucible Divergence Point:**
1. *Flee into the Subterranean Dungeon (Canon):* Accept the alien voice's terms and enter the death-game with only a cat and underwear.
2. *Scavenge the Crushed Surface Ruins:* Refuse immediate entry, searching the flattened Seattle rubble for winter clothing, military gear, and firearms before the surface air freezes over.

**Immediate Dilemma & Cost:**
Entering immediately guarantees warmth and tutorial chest access, but leaves Carl functionally naked and unarmed. Scavenging outside risks fatal hypothermia or being targeted by Borant cleanup drones, but might yield real-world ballistic weaponry.

**Long-Term Campaign Ripple:**
If Carl enters with firearms and winter boots, the AI never develops its foot-fetish fixation, altering his achievement rewards and eliminating the bare-footed brawler buffs that define his combat style.
---

quests.name: Milestone 2: The Awakening Biscuit Dilemma
quests.title: Milestone 2: The Awakening Biscuit Dilemma
quests.description: Upon unlocking a rare Celestial-tier tutorial prize, Carl receives the Pet Awakening Biscuit. Rather than selling it or saving it, he feeds it to Princess Donut, granting her human speech, sapience, high Charisma, and magical aptitude.
quests.notes:
**Milestone & Crucible:** Milestone 2: The Awakening Biscuit Dilemma (Q_M2_the_awakening_biscuit_dilemma)

**Floor & Phase:** Floor 1, Tutorial Guild #4 (`ph_02`, Floor 1 - First Blood & The Tutorial Guild)

**Canonical Outcome:**
Upon unlocking a rare Celestial-tier tutorial prize, Carl receives the Pet Awakening Biscuit. Rather than selling it or saving it, he feeds it to Princess Donut, granting her human speech, sapience, high Charisma, and magical aptitude.

**Crucible Divergence Point:**
1. *Awaken Princess Donut (Canon):* Transform Donut into a sentient partner and spellcaster.
2. *Consume the Biscuit Personally:* Attempt to eat the beast-enhancement biscuit himself for massive raw stat multipliers.
3. *Barter with Mordecai:* Trade the Celestial biscuit for a full kit of advanced alchemical reagents and military armor.

**Immediate Dilemma & Cost:**
Awakening Donut creates an outspoken, demanding feline diva who requires luxury food and emotional validation, but gives the team an incredible magical artillery asset. Trading or consuming it leaves Donut an ordinary, helpless housecat who must be carried in a backpack, drastically increasing the burden of protecting her.

**Long-Term Campaign Ripple:**
Without an awakened Donut, Carl loses access to the galactic broadcast talk-show circuit, eliminating his primary source of high-tier sponsor crates and intergalactic legal defense.

quests.name: Milestone 3: The Ball of Swine & Improvised Demolitions
quests.title: Milestone 3: The Ball of Swine & Improvised Demolitions
quests.description: Cornered by a charging Ball of Swine war-machine packed with sewer goblins, Carl combines nitrogen compounds and goblin incendiaries into a shaped explosive, detonating the entire warband in a single blast.
quests.notes:
**Milestone & Crucible:** Milestone 3: The Ball of Swine & Improvised Demolitions (Q_M3_the_ball_of_swine_improvised_demolitions)

**Floor & Phase:** Floor 1, Goblin Caverns (`ph_03`, Floor 1 - Ball of Swine & Clearing the Surface Labyrinth)

**Canonical Outcome:**
Cornered by a charging Ball of Swine war-machine packed with sewer goblins, Carl combines nitrogen compounds and goblin incendiaries into a shaped explosive, detonating the entire warband in a single blast.

**Crucible Divergence Point:**
1. *High-Yield Improvised Blast (Canon):* Detonate the chemical bomb at dangerously close range.
2. *Conventional Melee Defense:* Form a shield wall with surviving human crawlers in the narrow chokepoint.

**Immediate Dilemma & Cost:**
The chemical explosion inflicts severe shrapnel lacerations and burns on Carl, risking cavern collapse, but annihilates the boss mob instantly. A shield wall avoids cave-in risks but guarantees high casualties among terrified civilian survivors.

**Long-Term Campaign Ripple:**
The explosion cements Carl's reputation with the Dungeon AI as an unhinged demolitionist, unlocking explosive crafting recipes and permanently steering his build toward high-ordnance traps.

quests.name: Milestone 4: The Floor 1 Collapse Countdown
quests.title: Milestone 4: The Floor 1 Collapse Countdown
quests.description: With less than an hour before the 5-day timer expires, Carl and Donut clear the final goblin guard post and guide dozens of panicking human crawlers down the staircase to Floor 2 just as the ceiling crushes the first floor into flat stone.
quests.notes:
**Milestone & Crucible:** Milestone 4: The Floor 1 Collapse Countdown (Q_M4_the_floor_1_collapse_countdown)

**Floor & Phase:** Floor 1 Exit Portal (`ph_03`, Floor 1 - Ball of Swine & Clearing the Surface Labyrinth)

**Canonical Outcome:**
With less than an hour before the 5-day timer expires, Carl and Donut clear the final goblin guard post and guide dozens of panicking human crawlers down the staircase to Floor 2 just as the ceiling crushes the first floor into flat stone.

**Crucible Divergence Point:**
1. *Delay to Evacuate Stragglers (Canon):* Hold the doorway open until the final moments to rescue straggling crawlers.
2. *Seal the Portal Early:* Lock down the staircase to secure personal safety and prevent goblin hordes from overrunning the threshold.

**Immediate Dilemma & Cost:**
Holding the door leaves Carl and Donut within seconds of being crushed to death. Locking down early guarantees survival but condemns trailing humans to brutal mechanical compression.

**Long-Term Campaign Ripple:**
Saving dozens of civilians establishes Carl as the unofficial moral leader of the Earth crawlers, drawing the ire of Borant Corporation while building a network of loyal allies.

quests.name: Milestone 5: The Meadowlark Traitors (Frank & Maggie)
quests.title: Milestone 5: The Meadowlark Traitors (Frank & Maggie)
quests.description: Discovering that Frank and Maggie have been murdering fellow elderly Meadowlark residents for loot boxes and XP, Carl unmasks their crimes, neutralizes their threat, and secures justice for Katia and the survivors.
quests.notes:
**Milestone & Crucible:** Milestone 5: The Meadowlark Traitors (Frank & Maggie) (Q_M5_the_meadowlark_traitors_frank_maggie)

**Floor & Phase:** Floor 2, Slime Tunnels (`ph_04`, Floor 2 - The Slime Tunnels & Meadowlark Betrayal)

**Canonical Outcome:**
Discovering that Frank and Maggie have been murdering fellow elderly Meadowlark residents for loot boxes and XP, Carl unmasks their crimes, neutralizes their threat, and secures justice for Katia and the survivors.

**Crucible Divergence Point:**
1. *Immediate Summary Execution:* Blow the traitors to pieces with an explosive charge to demonstrate zero tolerance for crawler-on-crawler predation.
2. *Conscription as Live Bait:* Bind their hands and force them to trigger pressure traps and draw monster aggro ahead of the vanguard.
3. *Public Trial Before the Crawlers:* Hold a formal hearing to maintain pre-Collapse human law and order.

**Immediate Dilemma & Cost:**
Execution provides instant catharsis and eliminates treachery, but shocks delicate survivors who cling to pre-Collapse ethics. Using them as bait saves innocent lives but crosses into Syndicate-like brutality. A trial wastes precious hours against the Floor 2 collapse clock.

**Long-Term Campaign Ripple:**
Sets the moral boundary for crawler society: does Earth humanity descend into feral cannibalism for XP, or enforce collective solidarity against the showrunners?
---

quests.name: Milestone 6: Raiding Kraz & The Fertilizer Blast
quests.title: Milestone 6: Raiding Kraz & The Fertilizer Blast
quests.description: Carl raids Kraz's munitions workshop, securing barrels of volatile alchemical fuel. Rather than using them sparingly, he constructs a colossal multi-stage bomb to obliterate the Hoarder boss blocking the Floor 3 gate.
quests.notes:
**Milestone & Crucible:** Milestone 6: Raiding Kraz & The Fertilizer Blast (Q_M6_raiding_kraz_the_fertilizer_blast)

**Floor & Phase:** Floor 2, Goblin Alchemist Workshop (`ph_05`, Floor 2 - Kraz's Barrels & The Hoarder's Destruction)

**Canonical Outcome:**
Carl raids Kraz's munitions workshop, securing barrels of volatile alchemical fuel. Rather than using them sparingly, he constructs a colossal multi-stage bomb to obliterate the Hoarder boss blocking the Floor 3 gate.

**Crucible Divergence Point:**
1. *Massive Catastrophic Demolition (Canon):* Detonate the entire fuel depot in a single devastating shockwave to vaporize the Hoarder.
2. *Precision Extraction:* Siphon small fuel flasks for personal inventory, tackling the Hoarder with ranged archery and spell attrition.

**Immediate Dilemma & Cost:**
The massive blast destroys the sewer infrastructure, floods adjacent sectors with burning oil, and nearly deafens the party, but guarantees a one-shot kill. Precision fighting conserves reagents but risks lengthy melee against a toxic regenerating slime monster.

**Long-Term Campaign Ripple:**
Destroys an entire sector of Floor 2, forcing Borant to pay massive repair deductibles to the Syndicate and establishing Carl as the primary systemic threat to the show's profit margins.

quests.name: Milestone 7: The Broadcast Economy & Odette's Deal
quests.title: Milestone 7: The Broadcast Economy & Odette's Deal
quests.description: Princess Donut's dramatic personality explodes across intergalactic social media. Talk-show host Odette offers broadcast partnership, channeling fan donations into life-saving sponsor crates.
quests.notes:
**Milestone & Crucible:** Milestone 7: The Broadcast Economy & Odette's Deal (Q_M7_the_broadcast_economy_odette_s_deal)

**Floor & Phase:** Floor 2 Climax (`ph_06`, The Galactic Broadcast & The Descent to Floor 3)

**Canonical Outcome:**
Princess Donut's dramatic personality explodes across intergalactic social media. Talk-show host Odette offers broadcast partnership, channeling fan donations into life-saving sponsor crates.

**Crucible Divergence Point:**
1. *Lean into the Entertainment Machine (Canon):* Allow Donut to play the aristocratic pageant queen for galactic cameras to farm high-end gear.
2. *Refuse All Broadcast Exploitation:* Ban cameras, refuse sponsor crates, and crawl in total media blackout to avoid feeding the alien entertainment economy.

**Immediate Dilemma & Cost:**
Playing along feels humiliating and morally grotesque, but delivers high-grade healing potions, enchanted rings, and armor. Refusal maintains moral purity but severely starves the team of crucial supplies.

**Long-Term Campaign Ripple:**
Donut's celebrity status becomes the team's greatest shield and greatest vulnerability, painting a massive target on their backs for bounty hunters and rival crawlers in later floors.

items.name: Enchanted Pink Crocs
items.specs: Unbreakable bright pink foam footwear granting high traction and kicking impact.
items.notes: A garish pair of molded foam clogs in eye-searing hot pink, snatched by Carl from the entryway as his apartment building compressed into a concrete slab. The sadistically voyeuristic Dungeon World AI immediately developed a perverse fixation on Carl's bare feet and pink footwear, awarding unique brawler bonuses, enhanced kicking velocity, and special sponsor crates whenever he crushes goblin skulls in his boxers and Crocs.

items.name: Studded Royal Collar of the Chonk
items.specs: Jeweled velvet and leather feline choker boosting magic missile spell potency.
items.notes: An opulent tortoiseshell-velvet collar encrusted with synthetic sapphires and heavy studs, tailored for Her Royal Highness Princess Donut. Originally a top-prize show cat accessory, within the World Dungeon it acts as an enchanted arcane focus that channels Donut's haughty personality into pinpoint Magic Missiles and deafening Sonic Screeches.

items.name: The Awakening Biscuit of Sapience
items.specs: Legendary Syndicate Celestial confection granting human-level sapience, speech, and class access to animals.
items.notes: A glowing, gold-dusted prize pastry awarded from a celestial-tier tutorial chest. Smelling intoxicatingly of salmon paste and crushed catnip, Carl fed this treat to Princess Donut on Floor 1. It instantly restructured her feline brain, granting articulate human speech, immense Charisma, spellcasting capabilities, and the demanding temperament of a galactic socialite.

items.name: Mordecai's Indenture Survival Handbook
items.specs: Comprehensive tactical reference detailing Syndicate crawler traps, floor boss mechanics, and guild bylaws.
items.notes: A dog-eared, leather-bound holographic survival manual penned by Mordecai over multiple brutal crawl seasons. It contains heavily annotated Syndicate regulations, trap disarming schematics, alchemical formulas, and cynical commentary warning crawlers that the showrunners always prioritize viewer ratings over fair play.

items.name: Golden Floor Speaker of the Dungeon AI
items.specs: Pervasive audio projector transmitting sarcastic AI commentary and foot fetish announcements.
items.notes: A floating brass-trimmed acoustic orb projecting the omnipresent, unhinged voice of the Dungeon World AI throughout the labyrinth. It announces crawler achievements, level-up bonuses, and sponsor crate drops with scathing sarcasm, enthusiastically mocking mortal panic while delivering sultry commentary on barefoot combat maneuvers.

items.name: Katia's Heavy Hunting Crossbow
items.specs: High-tension mechanical hunting crossbow modified with steel-tipped penetrator bolts.
items.notes: A heavy composite recurve crossbow modified by Katia with precision tension springs and a hair-trigger release. Built to fire armor-piercing iron bolts, it allows Katia to pick off goblin sappers from maximum range while struggling with her own crippling dungeon anxiety.

items.name: Stolen Survivor Rations & Gear Pack
items.specs: Hoarded supply sacks stripped from abandoned Meadowlark elders containing stolen rations and medical kits.
items.notes: A bloodstained canvas duffle bag stuffed with hoarded nutrition paste, antibiotics, and stolen crawler tokens. Carried by Frank and Maggie after they callously shoved aside elderly retirement home residents to hoard survival supplies, making them pariahs among human survivor cells.

items.name: Kraz's Remote Alchemical Delay Fuses
items.specs: Precision chemical ignition strings tuned for synchronized multi-barrel detonations.
items.notes: Coiled reels of waterproof detonating cord treated with stabilized nitroglycerin compounds by the goblin sapper Kraz. Engineered to trigger simultaneously across multiple blasting zones, allowing Carl to orchestrate complex cave-ins and directional explosions against boss mobs.

items.name: Syndicate Live Broadcast Communicator
items.specs: Sub-space holographic relay beam transmitting direct viewer ratings, sponsor bounties, and media interviews.
items.notes: A sophisticated intergalactic broadcast receiver and holographic relay carried by Odette. It bridges the dark crawl tunnels directly with the glitzy syndicate talk-show studios, enabling live interviews, sponsor negotiations, and real-time bounty alerts from wealthy alien patrons across the galaxy.

items.name: Meadowlark Reinforced Riot Shield
items.specs: Scrap-metal tower shield built to defend wheelchair corridors from goblin sappers.
items.notes: A battered barricade shield improvised from corrugated steel and street sign plates by Brandon, the protective son of Meadowlark elder Chris. Designed with a wide frontal apron, it locks into doorway choke points to shield wheelchair-bound seniors from rushing goblin warbands.

items.name: Smuggled Slime Pipe Conduit Schematics
items.specs: Detailed drainage map charting shortcuts around the Hoarder's grave cavern.
items.notes: A hand-drawn parchment map sketched by Chris using charcoal and grease, marking hidden slime-pipe conduits and maintenance ladders beneath Floor 1. Bypasses the primary death-trap intersections and leads directly behind the Hoarder's digestive pit.

items.name: Improvised Fertilizer Demolition Cache
items.specs: Stacked drums of ammonium nitrate fertilizer wired to shaped blasting caps.
items.notes: A cache of improvised high-yield explosive ordnance concealed in Kraz's subterranean workshop. Packed with granulated agricultural fertilizer, sulfur, and diesel accelerants, this bomb pack gives Carl the raw destructive power needed to vaporize the Ball of Swine.

items.name: Unexploded Fuel Drum Core of the Hoarder
items.specs: Volatile hydrocarbon reservoir encased within the boss's central acidic jelly.
items.notes: A pulsating, pressurized chemical bladder recovered from the dissolved core of The Hoarder. Filled with concentrated bio-acid and flammable digestive bile, it can be harvested to coat ammunition with armor-melting slime or refined into lethal incendiary grenades.

items.name: Bronze Sponsor Care Package
items.specs: Reinforced bronze capsule dropped by galactic viewers holding healing potions and explosives.
items.notes: A gleaming pneumatic bronze canister beamed down from orbit into Tutorial Guild #4. Bearing the corporate holographic seal of intergalactic beverage companies, opening it dispenses high-grade restorative draughts, luxury pet food, and high-tech ordnance gifted by enthralled alien viewers.
